Reactive Resume V6, copyright (c) 2026 Amruth Pillai, MIT.

OGA ports the 17 template identities and official column/header ATS metadata to a browser-interactive React/HTML renderer. The source PDF components depend on Reactive Resume Forme engine; they are not directly executable in OGA React 18. Original PDF layout parity and pagination remain pending LOT 3. Letters in Reactive Resume inherit the chosen resume design (not 17 standalone letter source files). See original source: https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume .
